    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

    m.addConstr(I[t] == I[t - 1] + x[t] - demand[t], name=f"balance_{t}")
    m.addConstr(x[t] >= min_lot * y[t], name=f"min_lot_{t}")

        buy_cost[t] * x[t] + fixed_cost * y[t] + holding_cost * I[t]
        for t in periods
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

for t in periods:
    m.addConstr(I[t] == I[t - 1] + x[t] - demand[t], name=f"balance_{t}")
    m.addConstr(x[t] >= min_lot * y[t], name=f"min_lot_{t}")
    m.addConstr(x[t] <= capacity[t] * y[t], name=f"capacity_{t}")
